• Data sharing is mature

• Thanks to data management policies

• Code is the weak link

• Only 56% of code-generating papers share the code

• Preprints are climbing fast

• From 13% in 2018 to nearly 50% in 2024

• Protocols and registration lag

• 10% each. Newer practices, and more common in some fields than others
